Token.description: Opaque session token issued by `Auth` (`AuthResult/token`). The client stores it in memory and sends it as the first child `<token>` of every request except `Auth` and `SessionBegin`. It is also the `t=` query value of the web auto-login URL. Concurrent tokens are valid at the same time; `Logout` invalidates only its own token; no expiry was observed within ~45 min. Never log it.

Status.description: Service status code carried in every result (`<status>`). Values observed live plus those tested by the client.

oneOf.description: Success. The only value the client treats as success.

Unknown, logged-out or otherwise invalid `token`. The client re-authenticates (Auth) once per message (`message-relog-count`=1) and resends the message with the new token; session-bound messages are dropped.
Auth: user name does not exist. The client shows the credentials dialog.
Auth: wrong password for an existing user. The client shows the credentials dialog.

Generic failure. Usually carries a reason in `errorMessage` (e.g. `EmptyName`, `NameExistsAtDestination`); FolderFiles with an unknown disposition returns `Error` with `errorMessage` nil (`FolderFiles/invalid-disposition`).
RemoveFolder with `force=false` on a folder that contains files, or on an unknown/removed folder id.
FolderFiles: the disposition is a known value but not allowed for this call (`download`).

ErrorMessage.description: Free-text error detail. Nil for every status other than `Error`, and nil for some `Error` results too (FolderFiles with an unknown disposition). Values observed live: `EmptyName`, `InvalidCharacters`, `NameExistsAtDestination` (AddFolder), `NameAlreadyExists` (RenameFolder), `FolderNotExists` (AddFolder), `FolderDoesntExists` (ModifyFolder), `InternalError` (RenameFolder on an unknown id), `MovingIntoChild` (MoveFolder), `failed : requested file(s) not available` (Download). The client only logs it (code 3 path).

Disposition.description: What the files are requested for. The client maps its internal disposition 1 to `download` and 2 to `player.audio`, anything else to an empty string. The server parses it case-insensitively. FolderFiles accepts only `player.audio` (`download` gives `WrongDisposition`, other strings `Error`). Download accepts both values, but `player.audio` only resolves audio files: for other files it returns `Error` / `failed : requested file(s) not available` (`Download/audio-disposition`). RefreshFileUrl returns a url for both values, also for a non-audio file (`RefreshFileUrl/audio-disposition`).

ClientInfo.description: Client identification sent with Auth (`TeamSolutions.Chomik.DAO.ChomikBox.Client`). Constants built into the client, not read from base.ini. Optional and not validated by the server (`Auth/without-client-element`).

name.description: Client product name; the client always sends `chomikbox`.

version.description: Client version; the client always sends `2.0.8.2`.

SessionClientInfo.description: Client identification sent with SessionBegin (not verified live): the Auth `client` structure plus an operating-system description.

os.description: Operating-system string: `OS: %1 (ver. %2.%3) Build(%4) Architecture: %5 Service Pack %6.%7`.

CheckEventsStats.description: Client state reported with every CheckEvents poll (`TeamSolutions.Chomik.DAO.ChomikBox.Stats`). The client always sends it; the server also accepts its absence. The client writes the booleans as `0`/`1`; `true`/`false` are accepted too (`Service/text-booleans-accepted`).

panelSelectedTab.description: Index of the tab selected in the main panel.

animation.description: Id of the mascot animation currently shown.

BoxEvent.description: One client event (`TeamSolutions.Chomik.Library.DAO.ChomikBox.Event`). Names sent by the client (Observed; the client sends no others): `shutdown` (`poweroff`/`suspend`/`quit`), `detected.defaultplayer` (`0`), `settings.defaultplayer` (`0`/`1`), `settings.autostart` (`true`/`false`). Queued as `name=value;` in `[proto-box] box-events` while logged out and flushed after Auth.

value.description: Event value as text (`true`/`false`, decimal integers, or the shutdown mode).

Settings.description: Account settings relevant to the client. `downloadByBox` is the only member observed and the only one the client reads or writes.

downloadByBox.description: Whether downloads started on the web site are handed to ChomikBox. Mirrors `[downloader] enabled` in the client config.

MessageSequence.description: Chunking header for sequenced messages (`TeamSolutions.Chomik.Library.DAO.ChomikBox.MessageSequence`). With `[network] sequence-soap=true` (default config) the client sends Download requests in this form and splits them into chunks of `sequence-soap-download-request-chunk-size` (2000) entries, one message per part with the same `stamp`. **Verified live with conditions:** a non-final part is acknowledged (`Ok`, `list`/`accountBalance` nil, header echoed) and its entries are stored per session token, not per stamp, and not cleared by a final part; the final part returns the stored and its own entries if they are in one folder, `Ok` with an empty list if they span two folders, and `Error` if nothing is stored; agreements count only in the final message. See the Download operation.

stamp.description: Random correlation value, the same for all parts (a random number generated by the client). The server does not key stored parts by it.

AgreementInfo.description: A download agreement (transfer type) and its cost. Requests: the agreements the user accepted (the client sends every type 1-7 in the file's list, omitting `<cost>` when it is 0). Responses: each FileEntry has 7 slots, one per client type in the order own, small, free, edu, access, transfer, points; the offered agreement sits at its type's position (Observed: `own` in slot 1, `small` in slot 2, `transfer` in slot 6; the other positions Inferred) and the other slots are nil. Exactly one agreement per file was offered in every live case.

name.description:
Agreement (transfer type) name. The client knows a closed set (case-sensitive) and maps any other name to type 0, shown as "file(s) have been removed, moved to another folder or the folder password has been changed". Whether the server can send other names is Unknown, so the schema does not restrict the value.

| Name | Client type | Meaning (client texts) | Cost unit | Live |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `own` | 1 | Your own file; free, without limits | - (0) | Observed: cost 0 for own files |
| `small` | 2 | File under 1 MB; free, not counted | - (0) | Observed: cost 0 for other users' files under 1 MB |
| `free` | 3 | The file owner pays the transfer | - | Not observed |
| `edu` | 4 | Chomik Edu file; free | - | Not observed (the programme appears discontinued) |
| `access` | 5 | Paid recently; free re-download for a few days | - | Not observed |
| `transfer` | 6 | Another user's file, charged to your transfer | kB | Observed: 1654 for a 1,694,208-byte file (= floor(size / 1024)) |
| `points` | 7 | Author file, paid with points | points | Not observed |
| `hdd` | 8 | Client-internal: already on disk (also accepted from the server) | - | Never sent by the client |
| `queued` | 9 | Client-internal: already in the download queue (also accepted from the server) | - | Never sent by the client |
| `mixed` | 10 | Client UI state only (several types in one window), never a file's agreement | - | - |

cost.description: Cost of the agreement. Unit by type (client behaviour; consistent with the live values): `transfer` in kB (the client multiplies by 1024 for display; live, the `transfer` cost equalled the file size / 1024, rounded down), `points` in points. `own` and `small` were 0 live; the other free types are free per the client texts (server values Unknown). The client omits `<cost>` when it is 0, and a paid agreement (cost > 0) always opens its confirmation dialog.

DownloadReqEntry.description: One entry of a Download request.

id.description: What to download. Forms built by the client, in order of precedence: `<fileId>` (the normal case); `.<realId>` only for an entry without a file id (accepted with status `Ok`, but realId was never non-zero live, so it has never been shown to resolve a file: `Download/id-dot-realid`); `<hamsterId>/<folderId>` for the client's "download folder" action (unhandled server exception: `Download/id-hamster-slash-folder`); a folder path or an external URL; empty. The service also accepts paths: `/<user>/<folder>/<file>` and `/<user>/<folder>`; the latter returns the folder with all its files, own or another user's (`Download/folder-listing`, `Download/foreign-folder-listing-offers`).

agreementInfo.description: Agreements accepted for this entry (present only when the user accepted one). Without it the response lists the offered agreements and `url` is nil.

PlayListItem.description: One playlist entry. The client sends exactly one real id per item and -1 for the other.

realId.description: Real id, or -1: the client sends `id` when it is > 0, otherwise -1 and `realId`. Meaning Inferred (the stored file shared by copies); never non-zero live.

FolderView.description: Folder view options (`FolderView`). Not sent by the 2.0.8.2 client; accepted by ModifyFolder and returned in FolderInfo.

gallery.description: Show the folder as an image gallery on the web site.

TransferBalance.description: Transfer quota of the account. The client parses the strings to 64-bit integers and shows them in the panel.

value.description: Remaining transfer in kB (the client shows it as MB after dividing by 1024; consistent with the live `transfer` agreement cost = size / 1024). Live value 51200 = 50 MB.

extra.description: Extra (purchased) transfer; presumably kB as well (Inferred).

AccountBalance.description: Account balance returned by CheckEvents and Download; emitted to the UI as `accountBalanceChanged`. Download sums the agreement costs against it.

folderModifyTime.description: Time of the last change of the folder tree in .NET ticks (100 ns since 0001-01-01). When newer than the local tree the client refreshes it with Folders(0,0). This is the only "event" the service reports.

FolderInfo.description: A folder of the account tree (`FolderInfo`), returned by Folders (`folder`, recursively in `folders`) and ModifyFolder (`folderDetails`). Members are unprefixed (namespace `http://chomikuj.pl/`) and in this order.

name.description: Folder name (the account name for the root).

passwd.description: The folder is password protected. With `passwd=true` and an empty password the client stores the placeholder password `asd` locally.

freePoints.description: Free points: nil in every response, also right after ModifyFolder set a value, and for all 586 folders of the test account. The client stores it without displaying it. Meaning Inferred: points the owner sponsors for downloads from this folder.

freeTransfer.description: Free transfer in kB: nil in every response, as `freePoints`. The client multiplies it by 1024 and shows the folder tooltip "This folder has %1 of free transfer." when it is > 0; that never happened for the test account. Meaning Inferred: transfer the owner sponsors for downloads from this folder.

publicUpload.description: Other users may upload into the folder.

folders.description: Subfolders; nil when the requested depth is exhausted or the folder has no children.

password.description: Folder password, echoed in plain text by the service when set (`ModifyFolder/set-password`); nil otherwise.

description.description: Folder description: nil in every response observed, even right after ModifyFolder set one. Not read by the client.

EntryInfo.description: One audio file of a FolderFiles listing (`<EntryInfo>`, members unprefixed in `http://chomikuj.pl/`, in this order; `FolderFiles/success-with-audio`). The client reads `type`, `id`, `name`, `size` by name and walks the list by index.

type.description: Entry type. Only `file` was observed (six audio formats); the client compares it case-sensitively with `file` and silently skips any other value.

size.description: Approximate size in bytes (512-byte granularity, like FileEntry: a 1248-byte MP3 is reported as 1536).

FileEntry.description: A file in a Download result.

id.description: File id. Entries with id <= 0 are skipped by the client.

agreementInfo.description: Offered (or accepted) agreements: always 7 slots, one per client type in the order own, small, free, edu, access, transfer, points; the offered agreement sits at its type's position (Observed: own 1, small 2, transfer 6) and the other slots are `i:nil`.

realId.description: Real (storage) id: nil for every file seen live, i.e. own uploads, playlist copies and other users' files. The client stores it and uses it only for entries without a file id (`.<realId>` form, playlists, queue). Meaning Inferred (the stored file shared by copies); when it is non-zero: Unknown.

size.description: Approximate size in bytes (512-byte granularity: 100 B is reported as 512, 1033 B as 1536), not the exact length.

expire.description: nil in every observation. The client does not read this member; only the `expire` of RefreshFileUrl is parsed.

url.description: Signed download URL `http://sNNNN.chomikuj.pl/File.aspx?e=..&pv=..` (see `GET /File.aspx`); nil until an agreement is accepted. Reusable for several GETs.

DownloadFolder.description: A group of files from one folder in a Download result (`DownloadFolder`, parsed by).

hamsterId.description: Owner account id (another user's for other users' files).

hamsterName.description: Owner account name (redacted as `{{OTHER_USER}}` for other users).

type.description: Always empty in observations (own and other users' folders); not read by the client.

globalId.description: Folder path `/<user>/<folder>`; with `http://chomikuj.pl` in front it is the folder's public web page (`openPublicFolderPage`, Observed). The client copies it into every file of the group and uses it only as a fallback id.

AuthRequest.description: Parameters of `Auth` in wire order, all in `http://chomikuj.pl/`.

name.description: Account (hamster) login name, from the login dialog or `[userinfo] login`.

passHash.description: Lower-case hex MD5 of the UTF-8 password, unsalted (stored as `password-hash` when "remember me" is set). Secret: never log.

ver.description: Protocol version; the client always sends 4 (`PUSH 0x4` at). Not validated by the server (`Auth/protocol-version-1`).

client.description: Client identification; optional for the server.

token.description: Session token. Always the first child.

locale.description: Optional locale. Exists in the server contract but the 2.0.8.2 client never sends it.

token.description: Session token. Always the first child.

stats.description: Client state; always sent by the client, optional for the server.

token.description: Session token. Always the first child.

timestamp.description: Timestamp; the server type is string. The client always sends `0`.

events.description: Events (`Event` items), queued while logged out and sent in one call.

passHash.description: MD5 of the password, as in Auth.

client.description: Client identification including the OS string.

TokenOnlyRequest.description: A request whose only parameter is the session token (GetSettings, which the client never sends).

token.description: Session token. Always the first child.
Session token. Always the first child.

settings.description: New settings; the client sends only `downloadByBox` (= `[downloader] enabled`).

token.description: Session token. Always the first child.

hamsterId.description: Account id whose tree is requested (the client sends its own, from AuthResult).

folderId.description: Folder to start from; 0 = account root. An unknown id silently returns the root (`Folders/nonexistent-folder`).

depth.description: Levels to return: 0 = whole subtree (the client always sends 0), 1 = the folder only, 2 = folder plus children, ...

token.description: Session token. Always the first child.

disposition.description: Must be `player.audio` (the call lists audio files only).

token.description: Session token. Always the first child.

newFolderId.description: **Parent** folder id (0 = account root), despite the name (verified live).

name.description: Name of the new folder. Empty gives `EmptyName`; `/ : * ?` and similar give `InvalidCharacters`; a duplicate gives `NameExistsAtDestination`.

token.description: Session token. Always the first child.

force.description: `false` refuses only folders that contain files (`NotEmptyOrNotExistsFolder`); a folder with only subfolders is removed with them. `true` removes files and subfolders.

token.description: Session token. Always the first child.

folderId.description: Folder to rename. An unknown id gives `Error`/`InternalError`.

name.description: New name (same validation as AddFolder, but a duplicate gives `NameAlreadyExists`).

token.description: Session token. Always the first child.

newFolderId.description: New parent folder. **Not validated:** an unknown id moves the folder to the account root with status Ok, and `newFolderId = folderId` faults (HTTP 500) after moving the folder to the root.

ModifyFolderRequest.description: Parameters of `ModifyFolder` in the server's wire order (deserialisation oracle). Omitted or `i:nil` parameters mean "unchanged". The 2.0.8.2 client sends `token`, `folderId` and then only the changed fields among `name`, `password`, `hidden`, `adult`, `public`; it never sends `freePoints`, `freeTransfer`, `publicUpload`, `description` or `view`.

token.description: Session token. Always the first child.

folderId.description: Folder to modify. An unknown id gives `Error`/`FolderDoesntExists`.

password.description: New folder password; empty string removes the password.

public.description: **Client-only element.** ChomikBox 2.0.8.2 sends its "public" flag under this name, but the server has no such parameter and silently ignores it (`ModifyFolder/client-public-element-ignored`: `<public>0</public>` was sent and `publicUpload` stayed `true`, its value from the preceding `set-public-upload` call). The server parameter is `publicUpload`. Documented so that captured client traffic validates.

freePoints.description: Server-only parameter of CLR type `Nullable<Int32>` (named in its DeserializationFailed fault), never sent by the client. **Accepted and ignored**: values in the Int32 range (0, 1, 100, -1 and 2147483647 observed) return `Ok`, are not echoed and have no observable effect. A value outside that range (2147483648), a non-numeric value or an empty element gives HTTP 500 `a:DeserializationFailed` (all Observed). `minimum`/`maximum` state the Int32 range. Meaning Inferred: points the folder owner sponsors (hidden "Free points" group in the client).

freeTransfer.description: Server-only parameter of CLR type `Nullable<Int32>` (named in its DeserializationFailed fault), never sent by the client. **Accepted and ignored**: values in the Int32 range (0, 1, -1, 1048576 and 2147483647 observed) return `Ok`, are not echoed and have no observable effect. A non-numeric value or an empty element gives HTTP 500 `a:DeserializationFailed` (Observed); a value outside the Int32 range was tried only for `freePoints`, and the same fault is expected here because the fault names the same CLR type (Inferred). `minimum`/`maximum` state the Int32 range. Meaning Inferred: transfer in kB the folder owner sponsors (hidden "Free transfer" group; kB as in FolderInfo).

publicUpload.description: Allow uploads by others (server-only parameter; the client sends `public` instead). Verified live (`set-public-upload`).

description.description: Server-only parameter, never sent by the client. **Accepted and ignored**: plain text, Polish letters with XML-escaped markup, an empty string and 10,000 characters all return `Ok`; the value is never echoed in `folderDetails`, never returned by Folders and not shown on the public pages.

view.description: View options (server-only; never sent by the client).

token.description: Session token. Always the first child.

sequence.description: Chunk header; sent when `[network] sequence-soap=true` (default config). Optional for the server; without it `messageSequence` is nil in the result.

token.description: Session token. Always the first child.

folderId.description: Target folder. Not validated when the ticket is issued (`UploadToken/nonexistent-folder`).

fileName.description: Name of the file to upload.

RefreshFileUrlRequest.description: Parameters of `RefreshFileUrl`, sent when a download link expired.

token.description: Session token. Always the first child.

realId.description: Real id (0 for own files in the captures; the client's "unused" value is -1). Ignored by the server when `id` is valid: 0 and -1 give the same reply.

disposition.description: The client always sends `download`; `player.audio` also returns a url.

token.description: Session token. Always the first child.

sequence.description: Optional chunk header (server contract); the client does not send it for SavePlaylist.

StatusResult.description: Result with only the common members (Logout, BoxEvents, SetSettings, RemoveFolder, RenameFolder, MoveFolder).

status.description: Outcome of the call. The client accepts only `Ok`; `BadToken` triggers a re-login, anything else is an error.

AuthResult.description: Result of `Auth`. On success the client stores `token` and `hamsterId` (a changed hamsterId resets the folder tree), then sends CheckEvents, starts its timer, requests Folders(0,0), SessionBegin (if enabled) and flushes queued BoxEvents.

status.description: Outcome of the call. The client accepts only `Ok`; `BadToken` triggers a re-login, anything else is an error.

hamsterId.description: Account id; 0 when the login failed.

publisherId.description: Always nil; not read by the client.

name.description: Account name as stored by the service; nil when the login failed.

token.description: New session token; nil when the login failed. See `Token`.

CheckEventsResult.description: Result of `CheckEvents`. Note the mixed namespaces: `a:` is the DAO datacontract namespace here, `status`/`errorMessage` redeclare `xmlns="http://chomikuj.pl"`, and `changes` children use a third namespace (`b:`).

status.description: Outcome of the call. Serialised as `<status xmlns="http://chomikuj.pl">` (default-namespace redeclaration, no prefix) in this result type.

errorMessage.description: Error detail for `status=Error`; nil otherwise. Same namespace treatment as `status`.

new.description: nil in every reply observed, including 15 probes right after uploads, ModifyFolder, SavePlaylist and folder removals; its type is unknown. The client never looks it up, so a value would be ignored.

settings.description: Current settings (`downloadByBox` is copied into `[downloader] enabled`).

GetSettingsResult.description: Result of `GetSettings` (never requested by the client; the same `settings` come with every CheckEvents reply).

status.description: Outcome of the call. The client accepts only `Ok`; `BadToken` triggers a re-login, anything else is an error.
Outcome of the call. The client accepts only `Ok`; `BadToken` triggers a re-login, anything else is an error.

folder.description: The requested folder with `depth`-1 levels of subfolders; the root when the folder id is unknown.

folderModifyTime.description: Tree modification time in .NET ticks (see CheckEvents `changes`).

status.description: Outcome of the call. The client accepts only `Ok`; `BadToken` triggers a re-login, anything else is an error.

entryList.description: Audio files of the folder (`<EntryInfo>` items): empty (not nil) when there are none or for an unknown folder, nil on error.

AddFolderResult.description: Result of `AddFolder`, in the DAO datacontract namespace (like CheckEvents). Only `folderId` exists: the `folderName`/`prevModifyTime`/`modifyTime` members expected by the client are not sent by the service.

status.description: Outcome of the call. Serialised as `<status xmlns="http://chomikuj.pl">` (default-namespace redeclaration, no prefix) in this result type.

errorMessage.description: Error detail for `status=Error`; nil otherwise. Same namespace treatment as `status`.

folderId.description: Id of the created folder; 0 on error.

status.description: Outcome of the call. The client accepts only `Ok`; `BadToken` triggers a re-login, anything else is an error.

folderDetails.description: The folder after the change (for an unknown id: an echo of the requested values).

prevModifyTime.description: Tree modification time before the call (ticks). If it differs from the local tree time the client refreshes with Folders(0,0).

modifyTime.description: Tree modification time after the call (ticks).

DownloadResult.description: Result of `Download`. Disposition `download` opens the agreement window, `player.audio` feeds the player.

status.description: Outcome of the call. The client accepts only `Ok`; `BadToken` triggers a re-login, anything else is an error.

list.description: File groups; empty for unknown ids and for a sequence whose entries span two folders; nil on error and for non-final sequence parts.

accountBalance.description: Balance; nil on error and for non-final parts.

messageSequence.description: Echo of the request `sequence`; nil in the plain form.

UploadTokenResult.description: Result of `UploadToken`. The client builds `http://<server>/file/?key=..&stamp=..&folderId=..&fileName=..[&imageSize=WxH][&locale=..]`, then posts to `http://<server>/file/` without the query (see `POST /file/`).

status.description: Outcome of the call. The client accepts only `Ok`; `BadToken` triggers a re-login, anything else is an error.

key.description: Upload key (32 characters); sent as the `key` part and as `?key=` of the resume check. Secret.

stamp.description: Numeric ticket stamp (18-digit, tick-based); sent as the `time` part and used as the multipart boundary suffix `!CHB<stamp>`. Secret.

locale.description: Locale for the upload server; sent as the `locale` part. Returned even for BadToken.

RefreshFileUrlResult.description: Result of `RefreshFileUrl`; the client restarts the download with the new URL.

status.description: Outcome of the call. The client accepts only `Ok`; `BadToken` triggers a re-login, anything else is an error.

realId.description: Real id; `0` for a playlist copy whatever realId was sent.

expire.description: Link expiry: nil in every reply observed. The client accepts only `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` (local time) and uses it only for the pause warning.

url.description: Fresh signed download URL; nil for unknown ids.

SavePlaylistResult.description: Result of `SavePlaylist`. A playlist is an ordinary folder under the top-level `Playlisty` folder.

status.description: Outcome of the call. The client accepts only `Ok`; `BadToken` triggers a re-login, anything else is an error.

folderId.description: Id of the new playlist folder (0 on error).

folderName.description: Name of the playlist folder: the requested name, or `<name>(1)` when a playlist of that name exists.

parentId.description: Id of the top-level `Playlisty` folder that holds playlists (created by the server at the account root when missing, reused when present).

messageSequence.description: Echo of the request `sequence`; nil when none was sent (the client never sends one).

SessionBeginResult.description: Result of `SessionBegin`. **Not observed**: the session host does not resolve and the client reads nothing from this result. Modelled on the common result members of the 17 captured operations.

status.description: Outcome of the call. The client accepts only `Ok`; `BadToken` triggers a re-login, anything else is an error.

SoapFault.description: WCF SOAP 1.1 fault (`<s:Fault>`), returned with HTTP 500. Detail is never included (IncludeExceptionDetailInFaults is off). `faultcode` and `faultstring` are in no namespace.

faultcode.description: Qualified fault code with its own namespace declaration on the element: `a:InternalServiceFault` and `a:DeserializationFailed` (a = `http://schemas.microsoft.com/net/2005/12/windowscommunicationfoundation/dispatcher`), `a:ActionNotSupported` and `a:DestinationUnreachable` (a = `http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2005/05/addressing/none`).

faultstring.description: Human-readable message. `DeserializationFailed` names the parameter and CLR type, which is how the contract was established.

UploadReply.description: Reply of the upload server. Root element must be `resp`; `res="1"` is success, anything else is a server error (code 1), HTTP >= 400 is code 1, non-XML is code 2 `(xml-parse-error)`. Served as `text/html; charset=utf-8` by `Microsoft-HTTPAPI/2.0` despite being XML. **Live:** success carries only `res` and `fileid`; the `filename`/`folderid` attributes read by the client are not sent.

res.description: Result code: 1 = stored; negative = error (observed `-42` "Bad token").

fileid.description: Id of the stored file (read by the client as i64).

filename.description: Read by the client but never sent by the service.

folderid.description: Read by the client (compared with the local folder, warning "folder mistatch!") but never sent by the service.

errorMessage.description: Error text for `res != 1`, shown in the uploader.

file_size.description: Bytes already stored for this key. If 0 < file_size <= local size the client resumes with `resume_from=file_size`; if larger it restarts with a new UploadToken.

skipThumbnails.description: Thumbnails already exist; the client generates them on resume only when this is `false`.

res.description: 1 = partial/complete data exists; `-31` = nothing stored for this key (also for unknown keys); the client treats `-4` as a network error and other non-1 values as "request a new UploadToken".

errorMessage.description: Error text (read by the client; not observed).

AuthRequestEnvelope.description: SOAP 1.1 request envelope for `Auth`: `<s:Envelope><s:Body><Auth xmlns="http://chomikuj.pl/">…`. No SOAP header is ever sent; `xmlns:i` is declared on the operation element only when a nil value is present.

encodingStyle.description: SOAP 1.1 encodingStyle attribute. The real client always writes it; the service accepts the envelope with or without it.

Body.description: Exactly one operation element; no other content (this also makes the per-operation envelopes mutually exclusive).

Auth.description: Operation element `Auth` in `http://chomikuj.pl/` (trailing slash is mandatory: with `http://chomikuj.pl` the parameters are not matched, see `Service/wrong-operation-namespace`).

UploadMultipartBody.description: Upload body as built by the client, in this order. **Non-standard framing:** each part starts with the line `name="<name>"[; filename="<name>"]` instead of a `Content-Disposition` header; text parts then carry `Content-Type: text/plain`, thumbnails `Content-Type: image/jpeg`, and the `file` part has **no** Content-Type line. The server parses positionally (name line, one more header line, content); adding a Content-Type to the file part corrupts the stored file. Boundary `!CHB<stamp>`; the bare `!CHB` is accepted too.

folder_id.description: Target folder id (the `folderId` of the UploadToken call).

key.description: UploadToken `key`. A forged key gives `res="-42" errorMessage="Bad token"`.

resume_from.description: Byte offset to continue from; only sent when resuming (from the resume check `file_size`). The file part then contains the bytes from this offset.

medthumb.description: Medium JPEG thumbnail; only when its size differs from `thumb`.

client.description: Client tag `%1-%2` = base.ini title + version (Inferred `ChomikBox-2.0.8.2`); 5 of 6 captures send `ChomikBox-2.0.8.2`. Not validated by the server: `chomikbox-2.0.8.2` is accepted too (`bare-chb-boundary`).

file.description:
Raw file bytes (from `resume_from` if resuming), `filename=` = the UploadToken `fileName` (UTF-8). **The part has no Content-Type line** (header block = exactly `name="file"; filename="<name>"`); there is deliberately no `contentMediaType` here because an OAS-driven generator would emit it as a header, and `Content-Type: application/octet-stream` makes the server store a leading `
`. Followed by `
--!CHB<stamp>--
`.

x-part-headers.description: Exact header lines of each part, in order, between the delimiter line `--!CHB<stamp>` and the blank line. OpenAPI cannot express a part without Content-Type or a part named without Content-Disposition, so generators must special-case this body. tools/validate.mjs checks every multipart example against this table.

CrashReportBody.description: Crash report built by `crashsender.exe` for project `chomikbox`. Text parts carry `Content-Disposition: form-data; name="<n>"; ` (note the trailing `; `), `Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8` and a claimed `Content-Transfer-Encoding: quoted-printable` although the value is raw UTF-8. File parts use `Content-Type: Application/Octet`; missing files are skipped. Boundary = a timestamp-based string (`CS` + date/time in the form `ddMMdyyhhmmsszzz`). **Privacy:** `conf.ini` contains the login, the password MD5 and proxy credentials, and `message.log` can exceed 100 MB.

project.description: Project name (`chomikfile` for the sibling product, which sends `serverIds`/`settings` instead of the queue files).

arch.description: Architecture string passed by the client: the constant `win32`.

checkSum.description: Lower-case hex MD5 of `<project>-<version>.<arch>`, i.e. of the constant `chomikbox-2.0.8.2.win32` for this build (an integrity tag, no key).

SoapFault.description: WCF SOAP fault (HTTP 500, `Content-Type: text/xml; charset=utf-8`, not compressed). Possible for every SOAP operation: an empty or malformed body gives `a:InternalServiceFault`, an undeserialisable value `a:DeserializationFailed`, an unknown or missing SOAPAction `a:ActionNotSupported`. Operations with an operation-specific captured fault document it inline instead.

x-security-notes.text: Out-of-order or wrong-namespace parameters are silently dropped (null/0); some malformed requests (operation element without the trailing slash, the `hamsterId/folderId` Download id, an empty Auth) trigger an unhandled `a:InternalServiceFault`. The client's own "download folder" action builds exactly that `hamsterId/folderId` id, so that feature presumably fails against today's server (Inferred).

Contract disclosure through faults and headers: `a:DeserializationFailed` names parameters and CLR types, `a:DestinationUnreachable` leaks internal origin host names, and responses carry `x-powered-by: ASP.NET` and `x-server`.

boxToken.description: The SOAP session token (`AuthResult/token`) passed as `t=` to the web auto-login URL. The SOAP operations themselves carry the token inside the XML body (`<token>`), which OpenAPI security schemes cannot express; see `x-session`.
